title: 第1章 灵鞭显威第2章 神剑州
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
陆家的秘密
沉翔虽然住在太丹王院，但这里还是给了他一个住的地方。当他看到院子里一个可爱又甜美的女孩，还有一个成熟风韵的女孩时，他不禁暗暗惊讶。
“柔柔，你怎么来了？”
祝融急忙问道。
“姐姐，这里好像是男人的住处，你们女孩子不能随便进来啊！”
云小刀脸色变得惨白，时不时的看一眼祝柔柔。
云素衣声音温暖又迷人：“你放心，我陪柔柔来看你的。”
沉翔戳了戳祝融的腰，低声问道：“这到底是怎么回事？你妹妹和小刀是什么关系？”
“呃……我本来就不想认云小流氓为姐夫，唉，反正我也做不到，我得向你表白。”
祝融一脸无奈的说道。与此同时，云小刀也长长地叹了口气。
沉翔突然想笑，但还是忍住了，“既然已经预定了，那你为什么要把你妹妹介绍给我呢？”
“哈哈……你要是看上了柔柔，那她就不可能嫁给云小流氓，怎么说呢……你比云小流氓强多了。”
祝融羞愧地低声答道。
沉翔呵呵一笑，“小刀，你老婆也不错，你怎么会灰心丧气呢！”
“她是好啊，只是一想到叫这只猪为姐夫，我就觉得恶心！”
云小刀沮丧的说道。
“云小流氓，你可要恭敬的叫我一声兄弟啊！”
祝融也觉得不舒服，“我把妹妹给了你，你却便宜了她！你还敢骂我猪！”
“爸爸能娶你妹妹，就是你的福气！”
云小刀回喊道。

“你长得像个猴子，别自吹自擂了，我姐姐娶你是出于好心。”
祝融也开始大喊起来。
很快，他们又开始争吵。
“咳嗽！”
远处传来朱柔柔的轻咳声，“小刀，你答应我什么了？”
她的语气带着一丝微妙的严厉，让云小刀立刻闭嘴了。
沉翔突然发现，朱柔柔虽然叫柔柔，但她一点也不温柔。每天都会听到云小刀抱怨自己的妻子是多么的凶狠和严厉，想到这里，沉翔的脸上再次露出了灿烂的笑容。
【tln：柔柔柔柔，柔的意思是温柔。】
沉翔一掌拍在云小刀的背上，笑道：“你竟然结婚了，却不邀请我，真是缺乏兄弟情啊！”
“他特意没有邀请你，这个白痴居然还想瞒着你一辈子，哈哈哈……”祝融笑道，“陈弟弟，你的资料已经过时了，你都不知道。”朱家和云家的婚礼。”
祝柔柔和云素衣走了过来，沉翔第一次定睛地看着他们。朱柔柔看上去温柔甜美；她与云素衣成熟的魅力和火辣的身材形成了鲜明的对比。
“陈哥，你好！我经常听小刀提起你，不过他总是说你很忙，所以不能带我去看你！”
朱柔柔淡淡一笑说道。
沉翔笑道，取出两颗筑基丹。他把一份给了小刀，一份给了朱柔柔，然后说道：“你们结婚的时候，我确实有事，没能来，就当是你的结婚礼物吧。”
祝融顿时双眼放光，惊叹道：“陈弟弟，你真是好心啊！”
content_en:
The secret of the Lu family
Although Chen Xiang lives in Taidanwangyuan, this place still gives him a place to live. When he saw a cute and sweet girl and a mature and charming girl in the yard, he couldn't help but be secretly surprised.
"Rourou, why are you here?"
Zhu Rong asked hurriedly.
"Sister, this seems to be a men's residence, you girls can't just come in!"
Yun Xiaodao's face turned pale and he glanced at Zhu Rourou from time to time.
Yun Suyi's voice was warm and charming: "Don't worry, I came to see you with Rourou."
Chen Xiang poked Zhu Rong's waist and asked in a low voice: "What on earth is going on? What is the relationship between your sister and Xiao Dao?"
"Uh... I didn't want to recognize Little Rascal Yun as my brother-in-law. Alas, I can't do it anyway. I have to confess to you."
Zhu Rong said helplessly. At the same time, Yun Xiaodao also let out a long sigh.
Chen Xiang suddenly wanted to laugh, but he held it back, "Since we have already made a reservation, why did you introduce your sister to me?"
"Haha... If you fall in love with Rourou, then it is impossible for her to marry Little Rascal Yun. How can I put it... You are much better than Little Rascal Yun."
Zhu Rong replied in a low voice with shame.
Chen Xiang chuckled, "Xiao Dao, your wife is not bad, how can you be so discouraged!"
"She's nice, but the thought of calling this pig my brother-in-law makes me feel sick!"
Yun Xiaodao said frustrated.
"Little Rascal Yun, you must respectfully call me brother!"
Zhu Rong also felt uncomfortable, "I gave my sister to you, but you took advantage of her! How dare you call me a pig!"
"You are lucky if your father can marry your sister!"
Yun Xiaodao shouted back.
"You look like a monkey. Stop bragging. My sister married you out of kindness."
Zhu Rong also started shouting.
Soon, they started arguing again.
"Cough!"
Zhu Rourou's soft cough came from the distance, "Xiao Dao, what did you promise me?"
There was a subtle sternness in her tone, which made Yun Xiaodao shut up immediately.
Chen Xiang suddenly discovered that although Zhu Rourou was called Rourou, she was not gentle at all. Every day I would hear Yun Xiaodao complaining about how cruel and harsh his wife was. Thinking of this, Chen Xiang's face showed a bright smile again.
[tln: Rourou Rourou, Rou means gentle. 】
Chen Xiang slapped Yun Xiaodao on the back and said with a smile: "You actually got married and didn't invite me. You really lack brotherly love!"
"He deliberately didn't invite you, and this idiot actually wants to hide it from you for the rest of his life, hahaha..." Zhu Rong said with a smile, "Brother Chen, your information is out of date, and you don't even know it." The wedding of the Zhu family and the Yun family. "
Zhu Rourou and Yun Suyi came over, and Chen Xiang looked at them intently for the first time. Zhu Rourou looks gentle and sweet; she is in sharp contrast to Yun Suyi's mature charm and hot figure.
"Brother Chen, hello! I often hear Xiaodao mention you, but he always says that you are very busy, so he can’t take me to see you! "
Zhu Rourou said with a faint smile.
Chen Xiang smiled and took out two Foundation Establishment Pills. He gave one portion to Xiaodao and one portion to Zhu Rourou, and then said: "I was really busy when you got married and couldn't come, so just treat it as your wedding gift. "
Zhu Rong's eyes suddenly lit up and he exclaimed: "Brother Chen, you are so kind! "
